description:
(Passive) This character has an uncommon genetic condition that, unlike a disease, gives positive special abilities, which include increased physical strength, dexterity, and reflexes, as well as
an always-regenerating body that keeps itself perpetually youthful, never getting older than a teenage body, and having pure white skin as a fluke.  It runs in families yet is also found in people
who are unrelated to each other.  Whether or not two people who have it are related or not, both will have the same facial features, and often, but not always, the same personality.  People who have
it are usually male.  In some cases the condition also limits mental maturity to that of a teenager as well, but not always.  It is not considered a disability, legally or otherwise.
name: Genetic Condition

description:
(Class) Swordmasters live and die by the sword, and know how to wield and fight with various types of swords and
fighting styles, with one and two-handed swords, and also dual sword fighting styles.  Each has it's ups and downs.
name: Class, Swordmaster

description:
(Class) An Axemaster is much like a swordmaster, but their thing is axes and battleaxes of different types and fighting styles.
Axes, in general, are slower to attack with than swords, and can't block as easily, but with a good swing can cut deeper.
name: Class, Axemaster

description:
(Class) The Samurai is a noble warrior who lives by ethics and honor, and not just their weapon of choice, the katana.
They can use magic points for spiritual sword attacks in combat, using their focus and spirit as they strike.
name: Class, Samurai

description:
(Class) The Ninja fights with not only the ninja's sword, the ninjato, but also with ninja magic that uses
sneaky tricks of sorts that can disable, debilitate, blind, deafen, poison, and do more to enemies.
name: Class, Ninja

description:
(Class) The Rifleman is a soldier and warrior who fights his/her opponents not with a sword or other blade, but with bullets and live hand grenades.
They use magic points for specialist spells that create and fling magical grenades, and their firearms can sometimes attack multiple opponents at a time.
name: Class, Rifleman

description:
(Class) A Cleric is a religious spellcaster that draws upon the power of his/her diety and religion for casting spells related to healing,
curing diseases and curses, and bringing defeated companions back to life after they fall in combat.  Clerics are also good at fighting the undead.
name: Class, Cleric

description:
(Class) The Combat Mage, or simply Mage for short, is a specialist spellcaster that can only wield magics related to blasting things and directly causing damage from various magical
elements, and not much else, and therefore has a limited number of spells they can cast, yet they are very good at the spells they cast, casting them better than a general wizard does.
name: Class, Combat Mage

description:
(Class) The wizard is a general all-purpose spellcaster that doesn't specialize in any specific type or sort of magic, but at the same time doesn't excel or have extreme
skill in any type of magic either.  Their advantage is that they have a large number of spells to choose from in their spellbooks, for nearly any occasion.
name: Class, Wizard

description:
(Class) The Martial Artist is skilled in unarmed combat, knowing how to fight without weapons with a variety of techniques.  When equipped with their handbooks,
they have a number of melee skills they can use.  As a backup, they have a few basic weapons they can also equip, as the usual primary and secondary, plus backup weapons.
name: Class, Martial Artist

description:
(Class) The Kensei is a sword master or
"sword saint," and is a legendary
individual of the world they live in.
There is a maximum of only one Kensei in
any world.  A kensei has extreme skill
and expertise in all swords of all kinds,
and is very special.  Becoming a kensei
is a great honor that very few can ever
hope to qualify for.  A kensei is also a
legendary hero of outstanding
accomplishment, with qualities that are
unmatched and recognized by people of his
or her world.
name: Class, Kensei

description:
With this ability, you take a second or two to catch your breath, refocus, and do something about any wounds you have.  Uses tactical points.  Amount healed varies and is dependent upon maximum HP.
Wounds heal without scarring, blemishes, pain, or permanant damage of any kind.  Even works with severed, missing body parts.  Characters with a genetic quirk have this ability.
name: Fast Recover HP

allies in battle, partially blocking the
adventuring party's enemies from getting

enemy will attack himself / herself
instead of his / her allies, whenever an
enemy picks which of the adventuring
party to attack.  When the samurai does
this, it lasts for five turns.
